fields.label: UI theme
fields.description: Folio pairs leather and brass with parchment pages. Dungeon uses slate and silver. High Contrast uses solid surfaces and clear outlines. Applies to your interface independently of dungeon graphics.

fields.label: Soft tile lighting
fields.description: Coloured light with soft transitions into darkness.

fields.label: Terrain borders & blending
fields.description: Connected wall edges, shorelines and softer sand transitions.

fields.label: Wall material shaders
fields.description: Masonry relief, crystal facets and transparent wall refraction.

fields.label: Water & lava shaders
fields.description: Animated currents, molten seams and wave highlights.

fields.label: Reflections
fields.description: Visible light reflected on water and transparent walls.

fields.label: Smoke, mist & fumes
fields.description: Billowing native cloud silhouettes and light scattering.

fields.label: Spell & fire shading
fields.description: Animated fire, energy effects and projectiles.

fields.label: Emissive glow
fields.description: Soft glow around visible flames, lava and magical sources.

fields.label: Soft magical areas
fields.description: Soft circles for auras and umbras, with precise targeting preserved.

fields.label: Aura distortion
fields.description: Subtle travelling ripples beneath magical circles.

fields.label: Creature movement
fields.description: Short glides and foot lift between confirmed native positions.

fields.label: Environmental particles
fields.description: Embers, droplets, bubbles, dust and footstep ripples.

fields.label: Interface polish
fields.description: Subtle panel relief, highlights and short interface transitions.

fields.label: Motion preference
fields.description: Reduced motion freezes supplementary effects and disables movement glides. Your device's reduced-motion preference is always respected.

fields.label: Show tips
fields.description: Friendly advice the first time you meet something new. Essentials covers moving, fighting, items and staying alive.

fields.label: How often
fields.description: The shortest wait between tips. Warnings about immediate danger can appear sooner.

fields.label: Keep each tip on screen
fields.description: Tips never pause the game. Hovering over a tip holds it open.

fields.label: Text size
fields.description: Applies to tips and to this tip journal.

fields.label: Where tips appear
fields.description: Choose the corner of the dungeon view that gets in your way least.

fields.label: Highlight the button
fields.description: Outline the action button a tip is talking about.

fields.label: Let Jev choose
fields.description: When several tips fit, Jev picks the most useful one. This sends a short summary of your hero's situation to TypeSafe, which runs Jev. It never includes your name, account or chat.

presets.label: Classic
presets.description: The original aesthetic. No Premium treatment.

presets.label: Balanced
presets.description: Soft lighting and animation, without crystal shaders or aura distortion.

presets.label: Premium
presets.description: All enhancements. Dense scenes can be demanding.
